releaseNotes: v1.1.1+5: Fixed OCR item description interpretation to strip row serial numbers (e.g. 01..05) and unit rates (e.g. KSh 15.00 / kgs), added European/spaced total number parsing (18.000,00 / 12.000 00 / 14 740 00), text-month Order Date parsing, split-row Billed To client detection, and tightened invoice number matching.
